title: Garnet Telehealth deployment play notes
content:
Context:
- Customer: Garnet Telehealth (regional telemedicine provider; EMR vendor integrations planned). Evaluating Redwood Private (VPC + on-prem) for PHI workloads. Priority: privacy + predictable latency for live chat summarization and triage assist.

Attendees (2025-11-14 call):
- Dr. Asha Patel (Garnet, clinical ops)
- Mark Evans (Garnet, infra lead)
- Lisa Tran (Garnet, product)
- Maya Chen (Redwood SE)
- Diego Alvarez (Redwood infra)
- Priya Raman (Redwood security)

High-level ask / success criteria (customer):
- All PHI stays in their VPC/on-prem; no logs leave without explicit retention policy.
- 95th pctl latency for conversational path <= 700ms for 256-token requests, <= 1s for 512 tokens (soft).
- Fail-open behavior: if dedicated cluster overloaded, route non-PHI traffic to hosted fallback; clinical PHI must not be sent to hosted under any condition.
- Audit and KMS/HSM for key rotation and evidence for SOC2/HIPAA reviews.

Immediate risks / gotchas uncovered:
- EMR integration uses HL7 adapter that sometimes sends long notes (avg 800–1,200 tokens). Need chunking strategy. If we don't apply prefix caching / streaming, cost and latency blow up.
- Network egress: on-prem option currently behind older firewall that limits gRPC keepalive -> SRE flagged risk for persistent connections needed by runtime.
- HSM team requires FIPS-validated crypto; our current hosted KMS integration sample needs adaptation for on-prem HSM middleware.
- Model quantization: clinical quality tests showed small hallucination increase with 4-bit quant; need regressions on med prompts.

Technical notes / suggestions (rough):
- Deployment mode: Private VPC with optional on-prem inference gateway for air-gapped retrieval. Suggest split: PHI processing on on-prem pool, anonymized features/embeddings routed to dedicated-hosted for analytics (if customer opts in).
- Suggested cluster baseline for pilot: 2x A40 / A10 (48GB) nodes configured for continuous batching; can target 50 rps steady with 1–2s P95 for 512 tokens. (TO VALIDATE with load tests)
- Enable prefix/KV caching for repeated system prompts (triage assist common opener templates). Cache invalidation policy: 24h by default, passable via Console.
- Model versioning: pin Llama-3-13B-pt-clinical-v2 for pilot; create automatic fallback to smaller Llama-3-7B-quant when latency SLOs violated only for non-PHI traffic.
- Use Redwood Console rollout canary for config change; keep 10% traffic for canary, monitor token-level cost and hallucination regression (eval set).

Prompt / eval snippets to run (quick):
- Clinical summarization edge cases: long SOAP notes with nested meds lists, abbreviations. Create 20-case eval harness, compare L3-13B-pt vs L3-7B-quant.
- Safety / hallucination probes: patient DOB/SSN hallucination test set (must be zero hallucinations).

Operational playbook (short):
- Incident: P95 latency spike > 1.5x for 10+ minutes -> auto-failover rules should NOT route PHI to hosted; instead scale on-prem pool and alert SE + Garnet infra.
- Audit: daily audit log export to Garnet S3 bucket (encrypted) + weekly summary report in Console.

Open questions (action owners):
- Q1: Garnet legal to confirm exact retention window for logs with PHI (Maya to ping Lisa). OWNER: Lisa (Garnet) - due 2025-11-21.
- Q2: Can Garnet accept a short-term hosted fallback for anonymized analytics? OWNER: Mark (Garnet) - due 2025-11-20.
- Q3: HSM vendor details + API for key wrapping. OWNER: Priya (Redwood) to coordinate with Diego - ticket ENG-9155.
- Q4: Thresholds for chunking long notes — clinical team to identify minimum acceptable truncation. OWNER: Dr. Asha - due 2025-11-25.

Action items (concrete):
- [Maya] Draft pilot configuration (VPC + 2 on-prem nodes) and estimated cost delta vs Dedicated (EOD 2025-11-18). Linked to ENG-9123.
- [Diego] Run basic load test (synthetic 256/512 token mix) against 2xA10 baseline and capture P95/P99 (start 2025-11-17).
- [Priya] Run HSM compatibility checklist, identify middleware adapters we need for Garnet vendor (due 2025-11-21).
- [Jonah] Prep 20-case eval harness for clinical summarization + hallucination probes (due 2025-11-19).

Notes to self (quick brain dump):
- Keep message that Redwood can guarantee PHI isolation via Private + on-prem, but legal will want detailed logging and chain-of-custody docs.
- Emphasize that model quantization is a knob but needs clinical regressions — schedule a short QA session with Garnet clinicians.
- Consider offering a limited-time free play credits for the pilot's load tests to remove friction.

Meeting follow-ups:
- Next sync: 2025-11-20 10:00 PT (15m) to review HSM info + retention window.
- Workshop: 2025-11-24 (2h) with Garnet clinicians + Redwood ML to validate summarization outputs.

Random ideas (keep in backlog):
- Build a small redaction microservice as part of onboarding to pre-strip obvious PII before models (optional).
- Sample policy templates for audit reviewers (SOC2/HIPAA) that reference Redwood Console retention controls.

Bottom line (one-liner):
- High priority privacy constraints + variable input length -> recommend Private with on-prem inference pool for PHI, explicit chunking + evals before any quantized fast-path.
